data.name: Patient
quoteText: l experience prolonged anxiety while waiting for
results, with a lingering fear of misdiagnosis
10 minutes to scan, two weeks of agony.
The wait is worse than the disease itself.
Knowing doctors are overworked, what if mine was
tired? | need 100% certainty nothing was missed.
Doubting my first ‘normal," | visited three hospitals.
An Al double-check would have let me sleep.

paragraphs:
Anatomical Noise
In the chaotic grayscale landscape of a chest CT, a 1.2mm early-stage nodule looks identical to a blood vessel cross-section. To the naked eye, relying on standard 2D slice-by-slice review, this life-threatening lesion is effectively invisible—buried in anatomical noise and easily overlooked during a rapid 10-second scan review.

paragraphs:
Volumetric Isolation
MIRIMedi AI uses a proprietary ‘Deep-Focus’ filter to eliminate noise and analyze nodules in 3D volumetric space. By instantly isolating anomalies with high-contrast bounding boxes and ‘Malignancy Probability’ scores, it turns potential misses into actionable diagnoses.

data.noteHTML:
Focus: Worklist optimization (Crucial for ER efficiency)
- Action: Intelligent re-ordering of the patient
worklist prior to review.
- Logic: Critical cases (e.g., Pneumothorax) are
flagged with "High Priority" tags.
- Benefit: Prioritizes life-threatening conditions to
reduce emergency diagnosis time.

Focus: Worklist optimization (Crucial for ER efficiency)

worklist prior to review.

flagged with "High Priority" tags.
- Benefit: Prioritizes life-threatening conditions to
reduce emergency diagnosis time.

Step 6

Auto-Reporting (The Closure)

Focus: Reducing administrative burden.- Action: One-click insertion of Structured
Reports into the EMR.
- Content: Auto-fills findings (e.g., nodule
size/location) and clinical guidelines.
- Verification: The radiologist simply reviews the
pre-filled text, makes final edits, and hits "Sign."

instances.round5_markup:
Layer 1: Application

The Experience Layer

The visible interface that doctors interact with.

Clinician Dashboard

An intuitive, web-based command center for managing patient worklists and reviewing Al statistics.

Auto-Report Generator

A Natural Language Processing module that converts image findings into structured medical text, reducing documentation time by 50%.

Viewer Integration Plugin

A lightweight API connector that renders overlays directly within 3rd-party PACS viewers without lag.

Layer 2: Al Core

The Intelligence Layer

The proprietary 'Secret Sauce’.

Neuro-Net Engine™

Custom Hybrid CNN-Transformer Model.-CNN: Extracts fine details to detect micro-nodules.-Transformer: Uses context to separate vessels/tumors.

Data Foundation

Pre-trained on a massive dataset of 10 Million+ Annotated Images from diverse ethnic groups to ensure unbiased accuracy.

Self-Learning Loop

An active learning pipeline that automatically re-trains the model using confirmed diagnosis data from partner hospitals.

Layer 3 : Infrastructure

The Foundation Layer

Invisible backbone ensuring security and speed.

Secure Cloud/On-Prem

Flexible deployment options supporting both MIRI Healthcare Cloud (for scalability) and On- Premise GPU Servers (for data privacy).

Compliance Shield

Fully certified infrastructure meeting MIRI (USA), MIRI (EU), and MIRI 00000 standards for medical data protection.

Inference Orchestrator

Kubernetes load balancer auto-scales GPUs, ensuring <3s processing during peaks.

noteText:
Type

Usage-Based Revenue.
Structure

Variable fee applied to analysis volume exceeding the monthly cap.
Pricing

$1 - $3 per additional scan processed.
Target

High-throughput Health Checkup Centers with seasonal volume spikes.
Why it works

Lowers the initial barrier to entry while allowing us to capture significant upside from heavy users.
